description: Rename a collection, set whether it is commercial, set its description (plain text, up to 200 characters) or credits heading (up to 120 characters; the saved heading replaces the default in exported credits), or archive or unarchive it. An empty description or credits_heading clears it. A rename, commercial, description or credits heading change needs its current revision; archived alone does not and is safe to repeat. Archived collections are hidden from list_collections and search_collections unless you ask for them. A collection containing CC BY-NC tracks cannot be made commercial.

archived.description: true archives, false unarchives. Needs no revision when sent alone.

credits_heading.description: The heading of the credits block, up to 120 characters. An empty string goes back to the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, up to 200 characters. An empty string clears it.

name: update_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Update a collection
